name: Badland Nomads
background: The Gangs of New Eden are various factions of violent and deranged outlaws that wage eternal gang wars on the streets of New Eden. These gangs are joined by mercenaries which are not bound to any particular gang, and which fight for anyone that can provide riches or a worthy cause.

specialRules.name: Repel Ambushers
specialRules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

specialRules.name: Stealth Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Stealth. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Badlands Hunter
specialRules.description: When this model attacks enemies for the first time each round, unmodified results of 1 to block hits from weapons deal 1 extra wound.

specialRules.name: Precision Fighter Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get +1 to hit rolls in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Ambush Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Ambush. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Bounding
specialRules.description: When this unit is activated, you may move all models with this rule in it by up to D3+1".

specialRules.name: Enhanced Badlands Hunter
specialRules.description: If this model has Badlands Hunter, enemies always take wounds on unmodified results of 1 to block from Badlands Hunter (instead of only when attacking enemies that already finished an activation).

specialRules.name: Defense Debuff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which gets -1 to Defense rolls once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Melee Slayer
specialRules.description: This model's melee weapons get AP(+2) against units where most models have Tough(12) or higher.

specialRules.name: Disintegrate
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking units where most models have Tough(27) or higher, this weapon gets AP(+2).

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
specialRules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Bane when Shooting Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Bane when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Badlands Hunter Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Badlands Hunter. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Vengeance
specialRules.description: When this unit is fully destroyed, place as many Vengeance markers on the unit that destroyed it as models with this rule in this unit at the beginning of the game. Friendly units get +X to hit rolls with their weapons when attacking that unit, where X is the number of markers on it. The markers are removed once the next wave of reinforcements is deployed.

specialRules.name: Violent
specialRules.description: When this model attacks enemies for the first time each round, unmodified results of 1 to block hits from weapons deal 1 extra wound.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Violent
specialRules.description: If this model has Violent, enemies always take wounds on unmodified results of 1 to block from Violent (instead of only when attacking enemies that already finished an activation).

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: Only deploys D3 rounds afters its wave, and at the start of the round it's placed within 6” of a random AI Goal.

specialRules.name: Stealth
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule are shot from over 9" away, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls.

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Tough
specialRules.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Ignores Regeneration
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration.

specialRules.name: Bane
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking, the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.
